name: Altus AFB
description: Home of the 97th Air Mobility Wing. Primary training base for C-17 Globemaster III, KC-46 Pegasus, and KC-135 Stratotanker aircrews.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate.

gates.name: Visitor Control Center
gates.address: Main Gate area, Altus AFB, OK 73523

resources.name: Altus Dining Facility
resources.description: Primary DFAC serving aircrew training students and permanent party.

resources.name: Altus Main Exchange (BX)
resources.description: Full-service Exchange with retail, services, and food court.

resources.name: Altus Federal Credit Union
resources.description: Full-service credit union branch with 24/7 ATM.

resources.name: Altus Fitness Center
resources.description: Main fitness facility with cardio, weights, group exercise. 24/7 access available.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri 0500-2200; Sat-Sun 0800-1800; 24/7 for registered CAC holders

resources.name: Unaccompanied Housing / Dorm Management
resources.description: Dormitory management and assignments for training students.

resources.name: Altus Inn / AF Lodging
resources.description: Official temporary lodging and TLF. 24-hour front desk.

resources.name: Military & Family Readiness Center (M&FRC)
resources.description: Relocation assistance, financial counseling, employment support, family programs.

resources.name: 97th Force Support Squadron (FSS)
resources.description: Full MWR, dining, fitness, lodging, recreation, and family support programs.
resources.hours: See directory for individual facility hours

resources.name: Outdoor Recreation (ODR)
resources.description: Equipment rental, RV storage, and recreational programs.

resources.name: 97th Medical Group
resources.description: Primary care and TRICARE support for the mobility training wing.

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: PCS orders, CAC, medical/dental records, marriage and birth certificates if applicable.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact Dormitory Management (580-481-5218) for unaccompanied housing or Altus Inn (580-481-3311) for temporary lodging.

sections.body: 97 FSS and M&FRC for in-processing and community support.
